prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an original premium 3D cutout illustration for the right side of a personal director quotation on a digital agency website.
Primary subject: exactly TWO closing curly quotation-mark glyphs, together unmistakably reading as the typographic right double quotation mark ”. Each glyph is a thick sculptural rounded block with a short smoothly curved descending tail. These are quotation marks, never numerals or letters.
Composition: one coherent freestanding pair, the burnt-orange mark slightly forward on the left, the deep-plum mark subtly behind on the right. A gentle depth stagger, not widely separated. Nearly frontal orthographic three-quarter view with only a small perspective turn, so both quote silhouettes and tails remain clearly readable. Complete objects and their soft shadow fit inside the frame with generous transparent padding. A wide approximately 4:3 composition; subject group sits a little below the vertical centre.
Materials: beautifully crafted soft satin ceramic / resin, restrained rounded bevels and clean edges, substantial but calm. A mature tactile website brand illustration, not a shiny toy and not an inflatable balloon.
Colors: foreground burnt orange #d6490b and companion deep plum #261631. Preserve these two clean solid material families with natural lighting variation.
Lighting: large soft studio key light from the upper left, quiet ambient fill, small realistic semi-transparent contact shadow immediately beneath the pair. Refined volume and grounded presence. No colored glow.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background, including all open gaps around and between the glyphs. No visible floor plane, backdrop, white card, room, platform, or environment.
Constraints: ONLY the two closing quotation-mark sculptures and their subtle contact shadow. No text, words, letters, numerals, logos, branding, A1, speech bubble, graph, bars, arrows, extra objects, or borders. No cropping of tails or shadow. High-quality crisp render, suitable for rendering around 300px tall.
